note: Pinned grammar and shape aliases; no production JavaScript dependency.

sources.licence: CC-BY-4.0 data; BSD-3-Clause when incorporated into source code

reference.network: loopback module loading only; external requests aborted

boundedFlavor.depth: Limits.metadata_depth: 1..256, default 256; independent of diagram depth
boundedFlavor.budget: Limits.metadata_work: positive, default 1000000; also limited by remaining reader work

yaml.preflight: Alias-free physical-depth pass, then event-based logical alias depth and expansion work before recursive dependency weighing. JSON_SCHEMA numeric normalization preserves NaN/infinities, binary integers and overflowing-literal strings.
yaml.productionUse: pure shape-data YAML normalization only; no filesystem/process/network

normalization: Groups remain groups at every nesting depth; no lane ownership is inferred.
Pinned upstream database values are recorded independently of MoonBit.
Source trivia, diagnostics, canonical text and geometry have separate portable assertions.
